comfortable, air-conditioned rooms, a garden pool and genuine Tharu-region hospitality

reason: A hotel at the Chitwan National Park gateway in Sauraha that sells jeep safaris into the park; it is a village hotel outside the reserve, so the fit to safari-lodges is moderate (jungle-lodges also possible).
